note: The Central Bank of Seychelles' comparative table of bank charges (fees applicable 1 October to 31 December 2026), each bank's own figures: the Seychelles Commercial Bank's savings account costs 10 rupees a month and 15 more in a month its balance falls below 500; Nouvobanq's savings account has no maintenance or minimum-balance charge; the Seychelles Credit Union's personal current account costs 12 rupees a month. Absa's own schedule (effective 1 October 2026) charges nothing for keeping its Instant Savings Account and 15 rupees in a month whose average balance falls below 3,500. Banks whose minimum-balance charge doesn't say the minimum aren't written.
